faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about pricing

q1.question: What happens when I hit my memory limit?
q1.answer: You can still read and recall existing memories, but new memory creation will be blocked. Upgrade to increase your limit or delete old memories.

q2.question: Can I change plans later?
q2.answer: Yes! You can upgrade or downgrade at any time. Upgrades take effect immediately, downgrades at the next billing cycle.

q3.question: What are MCP Tools?
q3.answer: MCP (Model Context Protocol) tools allow AI assistants like Claude or ChatGPT to remember and recall information across conversations.

q4.question: How does team collaboration work?
q4.answer: Pro plan includes team invitations (up to 10 members), shared contexts with role-based access (Owner/Admin/Member/Viewer), and workspace-scoped API keys.

q5.question: What are private vs shared contexts?
q5.answer: Private contexts (all plans) are only accessible by the creator. Shared contexts (Pro only) are visible to all workspace members with role-based permissions for collaboration.

q6.question: How many team members can I invite?
q6.answer: Pro plan includes up to 10 team members. Additional seats can be purchased separately for $10/seat/month.

q7.question: Will there be ads in the Free plan?
q7.answer: The Free plan may display occasional ads to support the service. Upgrade to Basic or Pro for an ad-free experience.

q8.question: Is there a free trial for paid plans?
q8.answer: The Free plan has no time limit. You can try it indefinitely before upgrading to Basic or Pro.

q9.question: What payment methods do you accept?
q9.answer: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex) via Stripe. Enterprise customers can pay via invoice.

q10.question: Can I add more seats, memories, or API calls?
q10.answer: Yes! Pro plan supports add-ons: Additional team seats ($10/seat/month), extra memories, and increased API call limits. Contact us for custom packages.

q11.question: What happens when I add more team members?
q11.answer: Each additional seat ($10/month) also increases your workspace's API call limit proportionally, ensuring smooth performance as your team grows.

header.title: Your privacy matters
header.subtitle: We're committed to protecting your data and being transparent about how we use it.

intro.title: Our Commitment
intro.paragraph1: Kagura Memory Cloud ("we", "our", or "us") operates your-domain.com. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our service.
intro.paragraph2: We believe in privacy by design. Your memory data is yours, and we provide tools to control, export, and delete it at any time.

dataCollection.title: Data Collection
dataCollection.intro: We collect only the information necessary to provide our services:
dataCollection.accountInfo: **Account Information**: Email, name, and profile picture from your OAuth provider (Google).
dataCollection.memoryData: **Memory Data**: Content you explicitly store using our remember() API or MCP tools, including summaries, context, and details.
dataCollection.usageData: **Usage Data**: API call counts, feature usage, and system performance metrics to improve our service.
dataCollection.technicalData: **Technical Data**: IP address, browser type, and device information for security and analytics.

dataStorage.title: Data Storage & Security
dataStorage.intro: Your data is encrypted and securely stored:
dataStorage.encryptionRest: **Encryption at Rest**: All memory data is encrypted in PostgreSQL and Qdrant using industry-standard encryption (AES-256).
dataStorage.encryptionTransit: **Encryption in Transit**: All API communications use TLS 1.3+ for secure transmission.
dataStorage.accessControl: **Access Control**: Role-based access control (RBAC) with granular context-level permissions. Members can be restricted to specific contexts via whitelist.
dataStorage.infrastructure: **Infrastructure**: Hosted on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) with SOC 2 compliance and 99.9% uptime SLA.
dataStorage.backups: **Backups**: Daily automated backups with 30-day retention for disaster recovery.

dataUsage.title: Data Usage
dataUsage.serviceProvision: **Service Provision**: To provide memory storage, retrieval, and AI-powered features like Neural Memory.
dataUsage.serviceImprovement: **Service Improvement**: Aggregate usage data (anonymized) helps us improve performance and features.
dataUsage.support: **Support**: To respond to support requests and troubleshoot issues.
dataUsage.security: **Security**: To detect and prevent fraud, abuse, and security threats.
dataUsage.weNever: **We Never**: Sell your data, use it to train AI models, or share it with third parties (except service providers like GCP, Qdrant Cloud).

gdprRights.title: Your Rights (GDPR)
gdprRights.intro: As a data subject, you have the following rights:
gdprRights.access: **Access**: Request a copy of all data we store about you.
gdprRights.erasure: **Erasure (Right to be Forgotten)**: Delete your account and all associated data permanently.
gdprRights.portability: **Portability**: Export your memory data in JSON format.
gdprRights.restriction: **Restriction**: Limit how we process your data.
gdprRights.objection: **Objection**: Object to data processing for legitimate interests.
gdprRights.contact: To exercise these rights, contact us at https://github.com/JFK.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.intro: We use the following third-party services:
thirdParty.infrastructure: **Infrastructure**: Google Cloud Platform (hosting), Qdrant Cloud (vector database)
thirdParty.aiApis: **AI APIs**: OpenAI (embeddings), Voyage AI / Cohere (reranking) - only when explicitly enabled by you.
thirdParty.conclusion: These services have their own privacy policies and we carefully vet all providers for compliance.

dataRetention.title: Data Retention
dataRetention.intro: How long we keep your data:
dataRetention.activeAccounts: **Active Accounts**: Memory data is retained indefinitely while your account is active.
dataRetention.inactiveAccounts: **Inactive Accounts**: Accounts inactive for 2 years may be deleted after email notification.
dataRetention.deletedAccounts: **Deleted Accounts**: All data is permanently deleted within 30 days of account deletion (soft delete period for recovery).
dataRetention.backups: **Backups**: Deleted data is removed from backups after 90 days.
dataRetention.logs: **Logs**: System logs are retained for 90 days for security and debugging purposes.

cookies.title: Cookies & Tracking
cookies.intro: We use minimal cookies for essential functionality:
cookies.sessionCookie: **Session Cookie** (kagura_session): Required for authentication. Expires after 7 days.
cookies.noTracking: We do **not** use third-party advertising cookies, analytics, or tracking pixels.

childrenPrivacy.title: Children's Privacy
childrenPrivacy.content: Our service is not intended for users under 13 years of age. We do not knowingly collect data from children. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us at https://github.com/JFK and we will promptly delete it.

policyChanges.title: Changes to This Policy
policyChanges.intro: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes via:
policyChanges.emailNotification: Email notification to your registered email address
policyChanges.acceptanceNote: Continued use of the service after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

contact.title: Questions about our Privacy Policy?
contact.subtitle: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us.

customApps.title: App Authentication
customApps.description: Manage OAuth applications for Claude, ChatGPT, and custom integrations

featureGuide.title: What are OAuth Apps?
featureGuide.overview: OAuth Apps provide secure, token-based authentication for third-party applications. Use them when you need delegated access with scoped permissions, automatic token refresh, and user consent flows.
featureGuide.useCases: Use cases: connect Claude or ChatGPT as OAuth clients, build custom integrations with OAuth2 authorization code flow, enable team members to authorize apps individually.
featureGuide.howItWorks: Register an app (or use pre-configured Claude/ChatGPT) → Users authorize via OAuth flow → App receives access tokens → Tokens are used for MCP or REST API calls.

featureGuide.title: What are External API Keys?
featureGuide.overview: External API Keys let you configure third-party service credentials (OpenAI, Cohere, Voyage) per user. These keys are used for embedding generation, reranking, and other AI operations.

resourceTokens.title: Resource Tokens
resourceTokens.description: Manage authentication tokens for external data ingestion

featureGuide.title: What are Resource Tokens?
featureGuide.overview: Resource Tokens allow external systems to push data into Kagura Memory Cloud. Each token is scoped to a specific resource and context, providing secure, isolated data ingestion.
featureGuide.useCases: Use cases: product catalog sync, CRM data import, document indexing, event streaming from external APIs.
featureGuide.howItWorks: Create a token → Use it in API calls with the X-Resource-API-Key header → Data is ingested into the specified context as searchable memories.
